remarks: Welcome to this exceptional 2-bedroom, 2-bath patio home in the Mission Hills community in Hamburg, NY. Built in 2023 and formerly the Marrano model home, this residence showcases premium upgrades and designer finishes throughout that just won't compare to others! The custom kitchen and bathrooms feature upgraded cabinetry paired with stunning exotic quartzite countertops, brushed gold finishes, unique lighting, and like-new appliances and mechanicals all creating a truly luxurious, move-in ready, and worry-free living experience. The thoughtfully designed floor plan offers hardwood flooring in the foyer, kitchen, dining room and living room; custom draperies and window coverings throughout; and a convenient and spacious first-floor laundry room enhanced with plenty of cabinetry. Creative Storage organization systems have been professionally designed and installed in the pantry, coat closet, primary bedroom closet, and linen closet, maximizing the home's functionality and convenience. A 2nd level open-concept loft provides flexible additional living space, while the bonus sunroom features beautiful tile flooring, walls of windows, and a sliding glass door all overlooking the private wooded lot. Step outside to enjoy the beautiful paver patio complete with a brand-new Kohler awning, setting the perfect outdoor retreat. Additional highlights include an X Factor garage floor coating and numerous other model-home upgrades throughout. Experience low-maintenance luxury living at its finest in this meticulously maintained, better-than-new home...without the wait to build! See also ML#B1709020.
